articles.title: A Three-Headed Space Rock? Meet 44 Nysa, the First Triple Asteroid!
articles.summary: Scientists just found the first asteroid with three lumps stuck together—and it even has a tiny moon! 44 Nysa is 47 miles wide and hides in the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter.

articles.title: A Wandering Black Hole Just Ate a Star—and It Glowed Brighter Than 10 Billion Suns!
articles.summary: NASA's Swift telescope caught a supermassive black hole shredding a star far from its galaxy's center. The flare was as bright as 10 billion suns and happened 750 million light-years away.

articles.title: Roman Soldiers Shot Signed Bullets at Rebels—Like Ancient Trash Talk!
articles.summary: Archaeologists found 2,100-year-old slingshot bullets in Spain with a Roman general's initials. They were used to crush a rebellion and send a message: "We're in charge!"
